source_examples.unity:
# Combine all sources into one compilation unit
unity.c: $(SOURCES)
	@echo "Generating unity build..."
	@for src in $(SOURCES); do \
		echo "#include \"$$src\"" >> $@; \
	done

unity.o: unity.c
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c $< -o $@

# Fast single-file compilation
# Trade-off: No parallel compilation
source_examples.recursive:
# Top-level Makefile
SUBDIRS := lib1 lib2 app

all:
	for dir in $(SUBDIRS); do $(MAKE) -C $$dir; done

contracts: Regenerating an aggregate translation unit after one input changes must contain each declared source exactly once and compile.
Removing an explicitly configured source must remove its inclusion after the configuration changes.
A failing required sub-build must cause the parent build to fail even when a later sub-build would succeed.
An all-successful declared sub-build graph must succeed with bounded parallel jobs.
A documented profiling flag must be accepted by the declared Make executable; supported trace output is checked separately.
scope: Source-grounded component review, not an independent agent benchmark or speed comparison. Contracts fixed before native execution and maintained guidance edits.
